card.line: Pas-dammim was a place where Israel and the Philistines fought fierce battles, and where David and Eleazar won a great victory when the troops fled.

moments.title: Victory in the barley field
moments.text: The Philistines gathered at Pas-dammim for battle, and the troops fled from them. Eleazar and David stood in the middle of a barley field and defended it, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
